flags.item: CBO 10-year Treasury path sits below the observed yield
flags.reason: CBO's February 2026 outlook projects the 10-year Treasury at 4.1% (Q4 2025) rising to 4.3% (Q4 2027), with a two-thirds range of 3.5%–4.8% for 2026. Treasury's official par yield for November 10, 2026 is 4.98%, above both. The CBO forecast was completed December 3, 2025 and has not been updated on the page read.
flags.action: Do not use the CBO rate path as a central case for sale pricing or refinancing. Use it as a low-rate reference alongside the observed curve and the FOMC confidence band; re-read when CBO publishes its next update.

flags.reason: CBO's Table 2-1 (annual projections by year) is published as an image on the HTML page and could not be read as text in this pass. Only values stated in the report's text are published; the per-year 2030–2035 cells are left out rather than read off a chart.
flags.action: A reviewer can open the report PDF and read Table 2-1 directly if annual values are needed.

flags.item: FOMC rate projections moved up between June and September 2026
flags.reason: The September 16, 2026 median federal funds projection for end-2026 is 4.1% against 3.8% in June; 2027 is 4.1% against 3.6%; the longer-run median is 3.2% against 3.1%. Median 2026 PCE inflation is 3.7%.
flags.action: Treat any rate assumption made before September 2026 as stale. Re-read after each quarterly projection release.

flags.item: USGS Northridge 1994 loss figures differ between two USGS pages
flags.reason: The USGS Earthquake Science Center page states 33 killed, over 7,000 injured and about $40 billion in property damage. USGS Open-File Report 96-263 states 57 died, more than 9,000 injured and $20 billion in estimated losses. Neither page explains the difference.
flags.action: Both figures are published side by side. Do not quote a single Northridge loss figure from this site without naming which USGS page it came from.

flags.item: CAL FIRE Eaton Fire page: inspection status wording is inconsistent
flags.reason: The CAL FIRE Eaton incident page (updated August 6, 2026) carries both a statement that structures are 100% inspected and a statement that damage inspections are ongoing. The destroyed (9,419) and damaged (1,076) counts match the dataset.
flags.action: Counts are published as shown on the page; treat them as possibly not final and re-read before citing.

flags.item: City-level business counts not published in QuickFacts
flags.reason: Census QuickFacts marks the employer-establishment, employment, payroll and nonemployer rows as X (not applicable) for the City of Los Angeles. Only county values exist on the pages read.
flags.action: County values are published and labelled as county. No city or trade-area business count is inferred.

flags.item: Stress-history rows are county or metro-division series, not the site
flags.reason: The 2020 and 2007–2010 rows are BLS resident-employment (LAUS) and payroll (CES) series for Los Angeles County or the Los Angeles-Long Beach-Glendale Metropolitan Division. They are revised annually by BLS and the October 2025 LAUS month is not published. They show what happened to the area, not to this restaurant, tenant or parcel.
flags.action: Use them to size downside cases in the private worksheet; do not treat them as probabilities or as site sales history.

audit.result: PASS — no published value changed. 37 existing dataset rows were compared with their official pages and matched in full and 2 in part; 28 new sourced rows and 7 flags were added.
audit.detail: Re-read on 2026-11-12: Census QuickFacts city and county (all sections), BLS LAUS county series, FEMA National Risk Index county record, OpenFEMA declarations count, SEC Form 10-Q indebtedness and revenue notes, SEC third-quarter earnings release (first section), CAL FIRE Palisades and Eaton incident pages, USGS probability FAQ, CDI wildfire claims tracker, Treasury par yield curve, DOF E-1 press release (first section). New sources read: CBO Budget and Economic Outlook 2026–2036, Federal Reserve Summary of Economic Projections (September 16, 2026), BLS LAUS 2007–2013 and 2016–2026 monthly tables, BLS CES food-services series, two USGS Northridge pages. Not re-read in this pass (carried from earlier sessions' verification): DOF P-2A workbook, SCAG tables, California School Dashboard, SEC Form 10-K state counts, CAL FIRE hazard-zone acreage, CGS, Metro, EPA, LAPD, Port, tax and wage pages.
